text: EX-99.1 2 a20261028pressrelease.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 LCI Industries Confirms Receipt of Unsolicited, Non-Binding Proposal from Monomoy Capital Partners ELKHART, Ind. – LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII) (“LCI”), a leading supplier of engineered components to the recreation and transportation markets, today confirmed that it has received an unsolicited, non-binding proposal from Monomoy Capital Partners to acquire LCI for $101 per share in cash. As announced on June 30, 2026, LCI entered into a definitive agreement to combine with Patrick Industries (NASDAQ: PATK) in an all-stock merger to form a premier component solutions provider for the outdoor enthusiast, housing and transportation markets. LCI’s existing merger agreement with Patrick remains in place, and the LCI Board of Directors continues to recommend in favor of the Patrick transaction. Consistent with its fiduciary duties, LCI's Board of Directors, in consultation with its independent financial and legal advisors, has a responsibility to carefully evaluate Monomoy Capital Partners' proposal and will provide an update to shareholders in due course. LCI shareholders are advised to take no action with respect to the Monomoy proposal at this time. Perella Weinberg Partners LP is serving as financial advisor and Kirkland & Ellis LLP is serving as legal advisor to LCI Industries. About LCI Industries LCI Industries (NYSE: LCII), through its Lippert subsidiary, is a global leader in supplying engineered components to the outdoor recreation and transportation markets. We believe our innovative culture, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and dedication to enhancing the customer experience have established Lippert as a reliable partner for both OEM and aftermarket customers. For more information, visit www.lippert.com. Important Information About the Proposed Transaction and Where to Find It In connection with the proposed transaction between the Company and Patrick, Patrick has filed relevant materials with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”), including, among other filings, a Patrick registration statement on Form S-4 (File No. 333-299100) that includes a preliminary joint proxy statement of the Company and Patrick that also constitutes a prospectus of Patrick with respect to shares of Patrick’s common stock to be issued in the proposed transaction. The registration statement was declared effective by the SEC on October 19, 2026, and the Company and Patrick commenced mailing the definitive joint proxy statement/prospectus (the “Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus”) to their respective stockholders on or about October 19, 2026. The Company and Patrick may also file other documents with the SEC regarding the proposed transaction. This communication is not a substitute for the Joint Proxy Statement/Prospectus or any other document which the Company and Patrick may file with the SEC.
